content.comment_body: What should I do if I can't add more lines to my ladder diagram page?
In the diagram editor menu, there is an icon labeled 1-4. Clicking it opens the page layout editor, where you can select more pages for the diagram.
Hello, switch to FBD mode. Some functionality is unavailable in the Ladder Editor.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience constraints in the ladder diagram editor when the page runs out of lines. Options for adding more pages or changing the editing mode are not obvious. Some advanced features are only accessible in FBD mode, not in the Ladder Editor.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to increase the number of lines on a ladder diagram page or continue designing complex logic diagrams without restrictions.
